meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 它会先让你从四种症状里选一个:不调、参数错、循环/漏步、从零设计;再按分支排查。若你选从零设计,它会带你走定义、描述、类型、约束、错误格式五步;还会问你用哪个 SDK、建议先跑 mock 测试。它只做引导和指资料,不代写完整代码。
howto.when: 当你说到工具调用卡住——例如模型不调用工具、参数传错、循环不停等,或需要设计函数 schema——会触发。framework 问答、MCP server、生产监控等不归它管。

say.text: 模型不调用我的工具,帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 它先让你从四种症状里选一个,再按分支给排查方向。

say.text: 我这个工具的 schema 写坏了,参数老是传错。
我想为新工具设计调用函数的 schema,该怎么写?
say.note: 它会带你从 define 开始走五步法,不直接替你写代码。

howto.what_en: Puts you into tool-call triage: choose one of four symptoms (no call, bad args, loop, new schema), follow the branch. New schema goes through five design steps. Asks SDK; recommends mock test first. No code—only diagnosis and references.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention a stuck tool-calling agent: model doesn't call tool, args are wrong, loop won't stop, or you need a schema. Not for frameworks, MCP servers, or production observability.

say_en.text: The model isn't calling my tool. Help me diagnose.
say_en.note: It first asks you to pick one of four symptoms, then guides the branch.

say_en.text: My tool's schema seems broken; the args are wrong.
say_en.note: It routes to the wrong-args branch, checking type, required, and enum.

say_en.text: I want to design a function schema for a new tool.
say_en.note: It walks you through the five-step design flow.
